# SendPulse PHP SDK

Official thin PHP client for the SendPulse REST API. PHP >= 8.3, zero runtime
dependencies (ext-curl, ext-json). Returns decoded JSON as arrays; throws typed
exceptions on failure.

## Install

    composer require sendpulse/rest-api

## Authenticate

    use Sendpulse\RestApi\Client;

    $client = new Client(apiKey: 'KEY');                           // static API key
    $client = new Client(clientId: 'ID', clientSecret: 'SECRET');  // OAuth, token auto-managed

## Two ways to call

1. Chained (mapped endpoints) — $client->{service}->{resource}->{operation}([...params]):

       $client->crm->deals->getDeal(['dealId' => 5]);
       $client->smtp->emails->sendSmtpEmail(['email' => ['subject' => 'Hi', /* ... */]]);

2. Raw (any path, for endpoints not in the map):

       $client->get('/path', ['q' => 1]);
       $client->post('/path', ['field' => 'value']);   // also put / patch / delete
       $client->request('GET', '/path');               // or send(new Request(...))

## Calling convention (chained)

- One associative array argument.
- Path params (shown as {name}) and declared query params are routed automatically;
  any other key goes to the JSON body (for GET it becomes a query param).
- A trailing "!" in the catalog marks a required parameter.
- Returns the decoded JSON response as an array (empty body -> []).

## Errors

All implement Sendpulse\RestApi\Exception\SendPulseExceptionInterface:

- AuthException (401), ForbiddenException (403), RateLimitException (429),
  ApiException (other 4xx/5xx), NetworkException (transport), ProtocolException (bad JSON).
- AuthException / ForbiddenException / RateLimitException / ApiException expose ->httpStatus and ->rawBody.
